title: tc-reasoning-flags
description: Inline markers for weak reasoning in an answer, each opening a plain explanation.

text.description: The answer's text: plain text, shown as written (line breaks kept). Flags' offsets index into it

flags.description: The flagged spans, from the app: `{ id?, start, end, kind, explanation }[]`

kinds.description: Names and descriptions by kind, merged over the built-in ones

reconsider.description: Offer "Ask the model to reconsider" in each card (fires tc-reconsider)

noSummary.description: Hide the summary chip ("2 reasoning flags")

note.description: The line at the foot of each card – that the flags are automatic and advisory

hoverDelay.description: How long the pointer rests on a span or marker before its card opens, ms

ReasoningFlag.description: One flagged span: UTF-16 offsets into `text` (`end` exclusive), the kind (a key of `kinds`) and a plain-language explanation

ReasoningFlagKind.description: How a kind is named, and what the pattern means in general
